title: Vanilloid
description: Vanilloid aims to enhance the atmosphere of vanilla Minecraft without changing the core game play or adding heavy mods
body:
Vanilloid aims to enhance the overall atmosphere of vanilla Minecraft without changing the core gameplay or adding heavy mods

# (no custom armor, weapon mods ect)
​Instead of altering how the game works. this pack is all about making the world feel more immersive. It adds fresh visual and audio touches / smoother mob animations, ambient sounds, and "nicer" world generation without overcomplicating the game

## recomendations
1.This pack was built with the Ashen 16x texture pack in mind, I recommend enabling it for the best look

2.Optional Convenience Mods Xaero's Minimap, Xaero's World Map, are included for the convenience. If you prefer playing without a minimap you can safely disable or delete them
